versions.content: function operator== [SWS_CORE_00786] Upstream: RS_AP_00130 template <typename T, typename E> bool operator== (const Result < T, E > &lhs, const E &rhs); Compare a Result instance for equality to an error. A Result that contains no error is unequal to every error. A Result is equal to an error only if the Result contains an error of the same type, and the errors compare equal.
